title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 6306-2Z C3, two-year volume agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer for part:360020. The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

In our meeting of 27 June you said that multi-year volume agreements are what changes prices. We therefore propose a 24-month agreement for 20000 pieces per year from 2027-01-01, as set out in the attached term sheets. This gives you planned, steady volume and less order handling on both sides.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper equivalent variant of the 6306-2Z C3 is available from your range?

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 6306-2Z C3, two-year volume agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month volume agreement and have adjusted our offer accordingly. Our main offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an option, for a 24-month contract with 30 days payment terms, we can offer a unit price of €4.88. This alternative reflects a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our technical team will address your inquiry regarding a cheaper equivalent variant. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 (part:360020) - revised term sheets for a multi-year agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving to a 24-month agreement.

We have stepped toward your position in the attached term sheets.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Thank you for checking the cheaper material grade. Could you send the specification, so our engineering team can assess whether it is suitable for our pumps? Your owner offered on 16 June to walk us through your calculation. We would gladly take that up if it helps us settle the price.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 (part:360020) - revised term sheets for a multi-year agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

We are pleased to present our proposal with a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a contract term of 24 months.

Our technical department will send the specification for the alternative material grade for your engineering team to assess. We would be glad to schedule a meeting to walk you through our calculation as offered by our owner. Please note that our margin and our limits stay internal. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
